notes.title: Release of 1.2!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

With today's update you can now reset your progress and return to the main menu. This is a feature requested by the few of you who like to speedrun the game. Additionally, I have been pushing a few minor changes the last couple of days. These include:

[list]
[*] The control selection screen on startup should now more clearly communicate that the game has both WASD,  ← ↑ →, and space controls for keyboard users
[*] Slightly easier platforming in a select few places
[*] Less ants in a select few places
[*] Fixed a fox getting stuck on the terrain
[/list]

And congratulations to qipqip with a world record run breaking the 13 minute barrier!

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Release of v. 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi Everybody, 

Based on player feedback a few minor changes have been made. Still, if you had any confusion, comments, or ideas please let me know. Today's changes include:
[list]
[*] The player now reaches maximum and minimum speed immediately on pressing / releasing keys. This should make the game feel more responsive.
[*] Lowered the volume of the hoots of the first owl chick
[*] When colliding with walljumpable moss, the player slides down slowly, giving more time to execute a walljump
[*] The player can now flap their wings when flying more frequently
[*] Changed the font on the "Level Complete Screen" to fit the artstyle
[*] The player now renders above speechbubbles
[/list]

Enjoy!

Kasper [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589007/f7bfe287fa18a710d5a641613af00df492303a8c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589007/ad4f51980e711e41ae5ea72ef7aae83d5a0acf4f.png[/img]

notes.title: Release of v. 1.0!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everybody![/h2]

Version 1.0 was released today and I am very happy to see so many people already having fun with the game.
While I do consider the game to be in a mostly final state, this [i]is[/i] a first version and certain bugs, balance issues, or unclear design are to be expected.
So if there are any concerns, ideas or confusions you had while playing the game please let me know!

Kind regards, 

Kasper [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589007/f7bfe287fa18a710d5a641613af00df492303a8c.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589007/ad4f51980e711e41ae5ea72ef7aae83d5a0acf4f.png[/img]
